name: Mecca & Medina
hook: Hajj and Umrah, planned end to end
description: Pilgrimage travel handled the way it should be — flights, Saudi entry permits, and vetted accommodation near the Haramain, arranged by a team that treats the paperwork as seriously as the journey itself.
bestTime: Hajj falls on the Islamic lunar calendar; Umrah can be made most of the year

quickFacts.flightNote: Direct and connecting flights into Jeddah (JED) or Madinah (MED)
quickFacts.climate: Arid desert — extremely hot April–October, mild November–March

topExperiences: Tawaf at the Kaaba in Mecca's Masjid al-Haram
Prayers at the Prophet's Mosque in Medina
A guided orientation on the rites of Hajj/Umrah before you travel
Group departures organized around the Hajj season
